archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Future, Speed, Disruption) + TACTICAL MINIMALISM

typography.headings: Exo 2, Outfit, or Orbitron (Bold/ExtraBold/Black, tracking-tight, neon-glow text shadows)
typography.subheadings: Rajdhani, JetBrains Mono, or Share Tech Mono
typography.body: Inter or DM Sans (high legibility, tracking-wide for telemetry & code)
typography.font_pairing_notes: Never use Inter for Main or Sub-headings. Use Orbitron/Exo 2 for H1/H2, Rajdhani/JetBrains Mono for metrics and HUD controls.

visual_enhancers.scanlines: CSS repeating linear gradient overlay for CRT/Cyber HUD effect
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Animated neon border gradients on active wallpaper cards or monitor controls
visual_enhancers.neon_glows: drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] for primary actions and FPS/Performance counters

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (MODE B) with 12-column layout (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6)

bento_spans.simulator_hero: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 row-span-2 (Interactive Desktop Simulator with aspect ratio switcher)
bento_spans.live_controls: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 (Video FX Studio, Shader Controls, Audio Reactivity)
bento_spans.wallpaper_library: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 (Multi-format Library with tags, preview, search)
bento_spans.ai_shader_studio: col-span-12 lg:col-span-6 (AI Prompt to Animated Shader Generator)
bento_spans.script_exporter: col-span-12 lg:col-span-6 (Windows .ps1 / .bat & Wallpaper Engine / Lively ZIP Generator)

synthwave_retro.description: Wireframe neon sun setting over grid landscape

key_components_to_build.name: DesktopSimulator
key_components_to_build.description: Full interactive Windows desktop simulation with custom taskbar, start menu toggle, desktop icons, live audio visualizer canvas, FPS/RAM/CPU telemetry overlay, and aspect ratio switcher (1080p, 1440p, 4K, 21:9 Ultrawide, 32:9 Super Ultrawide).

key_components_to_build.name: VideoEnginePlayer
key_components_to_build.description: Multi-format player supporting MP4, WebM, MKV/MOV, animated GIF/WebP, HTML5 WebGL Canvas Shaders, and Direct HLS/Video Stream URLs with realtime FX filter overlay.

key_components_to_build.name: WallpaperLibrary
key_components_to_build.description: Gamer wallpaper catalog with search, filter tags (Cyberpunk, Anime, Synthwave, Sci-Fi, Rain/Lo-Fi, Gaming/eSports, Abstract), multi-res badge indicators, and 1-click active wallpaper assignment.

key_components_to_build.name: FXStudioControls
key_components_to_build.description: Real-time shader and video parameter adjustments: Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Hue Shift, Gaussian Blur, Speed (0.25x-2.0x), CRT Scanline overlay toggle, Audio Reactivity sensitivity, and Volume controls.

key_components_to_build.name: ScriptGenerator
key_components_to_build.description: Windows native automation pack generator producing downloadables/copyables for PowerShell (.ps1), Batch (.bat), Lively Wallpaper project format (.zip manifest), and Wallpaper Engine project structure.

key_components_to_build.name: AIPromptStudio
key_components_to_build.description: AI-powered creative studio that takes user prompts (e.g. 'Neon samurai in rain with glowing katana') and synthesizes animated WebGL shader code, procedural particle prompts, and visual parameters.

key_components_to_build.name: MultiMonitorStudio
key_components_to_build.description: Visual multi-monitor layout picker allowing distinct wallpapers and resolution profiles assigned to Monitor 1, Monitor 2, and Monitor 3.

key_components_to_build.name: PerformanceProfiles
key_components_to_build.description: Gamer profile selector: Battery Saver (30 FPS), Balanced (60 FPS), Ultra eSports (144Hz/240Hz), plus auto-pause simulation on full-screen gaming mode.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive buttons, sliders, selects, tabs, inputs, and canvas containers MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='aspect-ratio-1080p', data-testid='fx-brightness-slider', data-testid='export-ps1-button').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use generous Tailwind spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6). Ensure cards have internal padding to prevent content text collision.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.hover_contrast: Ensure hover states explicitly specify text color (e.g. hover:bg-cyan-500/20 hover:text-cyan-300).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high APCA text contrast against dark backgrounds (#F0F4FF on #0B0E14).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.animations: Micro-animations with Framer Motion or smooth CSS transitions on wallpaper switching, monitor drag-drop, and FX slider tweaks.
